thread:
Elliot: Massive thanks to Samira & Vik for the early-morning "latte lifeline" — customer demo at 6:30am and they rescued a cold-start perf glitch. you two are heroes. :coffee: :sparkles:
Samira: haha woke up early for the win. Vik isolated a model warmup gap in the starter path. small tweak and p50 dropped back to target.
Vik: added a tiny 500ms sleep in the container init to let caches hydrate — weird but effective. also shoutout to Jules for coordinating the customer-facing messaging.
Jules: thanks! sent the update and apology note, customer said demo felt smooth. nice teamwork. :raised_hands:
Elliot: i'll add this to the kudos wall and nominate you both for the "before-dawn rescue" badge.
people-ops: Congrats Samira and Vik! Sending an e-gift + recognition badge. Check your inbox. :tada:
Samira: omg e-gifts are the new flowers. thanks people-ops.
Vik: i'll add the warmup note to our infra runbook under "model warmup" with the snippet:
```
# model warmup: prevent cold-start latency
# add minimal delay to init to allow kv-cache hydration
sleep 0.5
# or trigger synthetic warmup requests after container start
```
Elliot: @ops-bot can you create a follow-up to formalize the warmup pattern and assign to Vik?
ops-bot: Created task: "document-model-warmup-pattern" assigned to Vik, due in 7 days. (https://tracker.redwood/issue/7788)
Jules: dropping celebratory GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-team-3o7aD6v3bXQ6 (party)
Elliot: Breakfast on us at the next retro if you want — small token of appreciation. :pancakes:
Samira: pancakes accepted. thanks again team. :heart:
